card.name: Unit words right after the number 5
card.fires_on: The word or symbol right after the number 5 (or five), such as mL, g, grams, patients or %. Also the digit 5 itself inside numbers like 74.5.

modes.label: Unit after 5
modes.description: A measure such as mL, g, grams or m follows the number 5.

modes.label: Patients after five
modes.description: The word patients follows five or 5 in a count of people.

modes.label: The digit 5 in numbers
modes.description: A 5 appears as the last digit of a decimal or number such as 74.5 mg.
